versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

- Clarified that the package outputs only scripts, shot lists, and subtitles, and does not default to a paid finished video.
- Updated input requirements to focus strictly on confirmed product facts; emphasized stopping when facts are missing.
- Refined workflow: Now mandates every spoken claim be visually proven and removes any suggestion of promising a viral hit.
- Minor documentation cleanups and clarifications throughout for greater accuracy and project alignment.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
